title: Trust operator CLI (cmd/trust) — authority generation, inspection, revocation, store bundle
release_gate: R2 wedge #5 — operator-facing half of trust-root workflow per spec 021 §5
acceptance_signals: All 4 subcommands (init, intermediate, inspect, revoke, bundle) execute in <2s on a clean macOS dev box
All Authority / RevocationList JSON outputs round-trip through `fabric_capability::trust_root` deserialize (verified via parallel Rust binary)
At least 12 hermetic Go tests covering each subcommand + JSON wire-format round-trip + signature verification
No external Go dependencies (stdlib only, including crypto/ed25519)
All output JSON matches the wire format documented in spec 021 §3 + ADR-0031
